title: Standalone Runtime Consolidation
summary: Replaced the manually duplicated standalone Solar System implementation with a generated single-file runtime compiled from shared application modules while preserving offline, zero-CDN, direct-file and ZIP behavior.
changes: Added dedicated standalone entry, bootstrap, UI and type modules.
Injected simulation Worker and planet texture sources into the shared SolarSystemRuntime.
Generated a versioned standalone bundle from shared celestial, orbital, rendering and fallback modules.
Reduced standalone-export.ts to approximately 3.2 KB of export orchestration.
Kept standalone HTML and ZIP export on one authoritative builder.
Added repeatable Chromium, Firefox and WebKit browser QA with desktop, tablet, mobile, offline, file and fallback coverage.
Stored all planet texture binaries in the source workspace and added exact production asset validation.
Added browser failure gates for all HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses.
Advanced the Service Worker cache to science-animator-v11-standalone-runtime.

publicationRepair.issue: planet texture files absent from initial dist caused HTTP 404 responses
publicationRepair.resolution: restored verified assets, synchronized them into public/assets/planets, added build and HTTP status gates, rebuilt and reran full QA
